Not because it didn't work, exactly, but because it worked differently every time I ran it, and I could not tell you now which of the four things I changed was the one that mattered. Somewhere around 2am I started keeping a text file of what I'd tried. That file is 340 lines long. It is the only artefact of that night I would defend.

fidelity-figures-and-names: The Instituto Vasco de Estadística was founded in 1989, out of the Basque Country's commitment to independent data. It is known as Eustat. It serves a population of 2.19 million and employs 1,438 people across three offices, and its work shows how much regional statistical bodies matter to policy.
fidelity-dense-technical: The root cause was the configuration flag gateway.pool.perRequest, which had been toggled to true. That made every request acquire its own connection from a pool with a ceiling of 20. From 02:14 the pool was exhausted and 83% of requests failed. The deployment was dep-4471.
